main_body: Round leaf canopy (rows 1-30) on a straight brown trunk with a root flare (rows 30-46)
top_band: Light yellow-green upper canopy dome, rows ~1-10, shading to mid and dark green below. It reads as a rounded volume rather than a flat slab.
evidence: The canopy is lit from above, with light greens on top and deep green on the underside. The deep green band on the canopy underside (rows ~27-30) shades the trunk below. The trunk is a vertical front face with a lit left half and a shaded right half, plus root flares at the base. No receding side face is drawn. For an organic piece this reads as a volumetric 3/4 form.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps and a dark green outline that matches the leaves, which is good. Its mottling is noisy and does not form defined leaf clumps with per-clump highlights and shadows, unlike the references. The trunk is split into two nearly flat tones, a light left column and a dark right column. Each is roughly 4x13 px with little bark grain, so it is a flat fill and thinner than the reference trunks, which carry roots and branch detail. Overall it looks flatter and simpler than the references.
